phases.title: Bind source and scope
phases.action: Inspect exact source targets and bind this capability to the selected project decision and permitted inputs.
phases.acceptance_template: Every existing target matches the expected source inventory digest; source edition purpose and unresolved scope are explicit.

phases.title: Specify the executable contract
phases.action: Write typed input output failure and effect contracts for the capability-specific behavior.
phases.acceptance_template: The contract states all capability input and output obligations and negative cases; unspecified authority remains absent.

phases.title: Capture the independent baseline
phases.action: Create source-derived positive fixtures and independent expected outputs before changing implementation.
phases.acceptance_template: Baseline fixture provenance is explicit and expected outputs do not call the future optimized path; held-out task labels stay outside indexed sources.

phases.title: Implement or verify existing behavior
phases.action: Implement the capability-specific change where required; if the exact baseline already meets the objective record evidence-backed NO_CHANGE_REQUIRED or verified reuse instead of forcing a rewrite.
phases.acceptance_template: The selected implementation satisfies the capability-specific output contract with exact source and test evidence; either a real patch or a verified no-change result is admissible, and neither alone establishes a measured improvement.

phases.title: Reject invalid and incompatible inputs
phases.action: Implement and execute the capability-specific negative cases without partial state publication.
phases.acceptance_template: Every declared negative case is exercised and fails in the intended bounded manner while prior committed state remains intact.

phases.title: Evaluate data-access optimization
phases.action: Measure avoidable data access and preserve exact reference outputs; retain the baseline when a proposed optimization does not improve the matched workload.
phases.acceptance_template: Optimized access must preserve complete declared outputs; BASELINE_RETAINED_NO_GAIN is valid when the candidate loses or is unnecessary, and all losses and unsupported cases remain explicit.

phases.title: Bind reusable functional memory
phases.action: Add explicit dependency keys invalidation and reuse rules appropriate to this capability.
phases.acceptance_template: Reusable outputs are keyed by every output-affecting source implementation and parameter; current host rights are checked independently at use.

phases.title: Compose existing module interfaces
phases.action: Connect this capability to its declared adjacent interfaces with typed handoffs and shared-source conflict handling.
phases.acceptance_template: The end-to-end handoff produces the capability output under real local interfaces; preparing a host action remains distinct from an observed authorized effect.

phases.title: Measure comparative workloads
phases.action: Benchmark the capability against the captured baseline on matched representative held-out inputs.
phases.acceptance_template: All declared capability metrics include measurement scope input identity sample count and losses; quality and integrity constraints pass before speedup is considered.

phases.title: Stress falsifiers and recovery
phases.action: Exercise the capability losing case maximum supported sizes interruption and stale-source conditions.
phases.acceptance_template: Counterexamples and resource limits are explicit; invalid state and failed dependencies cannot be promoted through stress or recovery paths.

phases.title: Review exact evidence and tradeoffs
phases.action: Review the source diff capability-specific positive and negative results integrated tradeoffs and unresolved domain obligations.
phases.acceptance_template: A review receipt identifies the exact implementation and checks; assistant review is not independent domain validation or community consensus.

phases.title: Stage a reversible META145 contribution
phases.action: Package the verified compatible capability delta with predecessor source pins migration and rollback information for the 145th integration.
phases.acceptance_template: The contribution is bound to this plan and exact accepted evidence; deployment canon changes and completed resident turns each require their own explicit receipt.
